workouts.name: Rønnestad 30/15s
workouts.primary_adaptation: Maximize time spent at >90% VO2 max with high aerobic power output

interval_breakdown.warmup: 15 min progressive 55–75% FTP (201–274 W) with 3 x 30s openers at 110% FTP (402 W)

workouts.name: Seiler 4x8 min
workouts.primary_adaptation: High-volume aerobic capacity and fractional utilization of VO2 max

interval_breakdown.warmup: 20 min @ 60–75% FTP (219–274 W) including 2 x 1 min @ 105% FTP (383 W)

main_set.work: 8 min @ 105–108% FTP (383–394 W) — maximal sustainable effort across all 4 reps

workouts.name: Classic 5x5 min VO2 Max
workouts.primary_adaptation: Increase maximal oxygen uptake (VO2 max) and cardiac stroke volume

interval_breakdown.warmup: 15 min @ 60–75% FTP (219–274 W) with 3 x 20s fast-pedal accelerations

workouts.name: Hard-Start 4x4 min VO2 Max
workouts.target_zone: Zone 5 (VO2 Max) — 125–130% start into 108–112% hold (456–475 W into 394–409 W)
workouts.primary_adaptation: Accelerate VO2 kinetics to reach maximal oxygen consumption earlier in each interval

interval_breakdown.warmup: 18 min @ 60–75% FTP (219–274 W) with 2 x 45s openers @ 115% FTP (420 W)

main_set.work: 45s @ 125–130% FTP (456–475 W) immediately into 3 min 15s @ 108–112% FTP (394–409 W)

workouts.name: Classic 2x20 min FTP
workouts.primary_adaptation: Raise sustainable threshold power and lactate clearance

workouts.name: 3x15 min Threshold
workouts.primary_adaptation: Build muscular endurance and extend time at FTP

workouts.name: 4x10 min Supra-Threshold
workouts.primary_adaptation: Pull FTP upward by stressing aerobic ceiling just above lactate threshold

workouts.name: 1x45 min Continuous TTE (Time to Exhaustion)
workouts.primary_adaptation: Extend Time to Exhaustion (TTE) at threshold and build time-trial pacing discipline

workouts.name: 3x20 min Sweet Spot
workouts.primary_adaptation: High-efficiency aerobic and mitochondrial development with manageable fatigue

workouts.name: 2x30 min Sweet Spot with Bursts
workouts.target_zone: Zone 3/4 (Sweet Spot) — 88–92% FTP (321–336 W) + 130% bursts (475 W)
workouts.primary_adaptation: Simulate hard group-ride/race surges while maintaining high aerobic load

main_set.work: 30 min @ 88–92% FTP (321–336 W), executing a 10s surge @ 130% FTP (475 W) every 5 min

workouts.name: 1x60 min Continuous Sweet Spot
workouts.primary_adaptation: Deep muscular endurance, glycogen storage capacity, and sustained climbing strength

workouts.name: 3x12 min Classic 2/1 Over-Unders
workouts.primary_adaptation: Improve lactate shuttling and clearance while continuing to pedal near threshold

main_set.work: 12 min continuous: 4 cycles of (2 min @ 95% FTP [347 W] + 1 min @ 105–108% FTP [383–394 W])

workouts.name: 3x15 min Lactate Shuttle (3/2 Over-Unders)
workouts.primary_adaptation: Enhance tolerance to repeated threshold surges and rapid metabolic recovery under load

main_set.work: 15 min continuous: 3 cycles of (3 min @ 92–95% FTP [336–347 W] + 2 min @ 105% FTP [383 W])

workouts.name: Gimenez Intervals
workouts.primary_adaptation: Extreme lactate clearance under tempo/sweet-spot pressure and VO2 max durability

main_set.work: 1 min @ 120% FTP (438 W) immediately into 4 min @ 85–90% FTP (310–329 W) — 45 min continuous

workouts.name: Crisscross Tempo / Threshold
workouts.primary_adaptation: Build race-pace durability for rolling terrain and breakaway efforts

main_set.work: 24 min continuous: 6 cycles of (2 min @ 102–105% FTP [372–383 W] + 2 min @ 85–88% FTP [310–321 W])

workouts.name: San Millán Zone 2 Metabolic Base
workouts.primary_adaptation: Maximize mitochondrial density, fat oxidation (FatMax), and Type I fiber lactate clearance

main_set.work: 100 min steady @ 68–75% FTP (248–274 W) — avoid coasting and avoid surging above 78% FTP

workouts.name: Long Polarized Aerobic Endurance
workouts.primary_adaptation: Deep aerobic durability, capillarization, and fatigue resistance without autonomic stress

main_set.work: 155 min steady @ 60–70% FTP (219–256 W), strictly capped below 75% FTP (274 W)

workouts.name: Endurance with Low-Cadence Torque (SFR)
workouts.target_zone: Zone 2/3 (Endurance + Tempo Torque) — 65–72% FTP (237–263 W) + 80–85% FTP (292–310 W)
workouts.primary_adaptation: Improve pedaling economy, Type IIa fiber recruitment, and climbing torque endurance

main_set.work: 6 min @ 80–85% FTP (292–310 W) seated at 50–55 RPM
40 min steady endurance @ 65–72% FTP (237–263 W) at normal cadence
